Angiex is conducting a Phase I clinical trial of AGX101, an investigational TM4SF1-directed ND-ADC. AGX101 is designed to bind TM4SF1 and deliver a cytotoxic payload to TM4SF1-expressing tumor cells and tumor-associated endothelial cells. This dual-targeting approach is intended to address both tumor cells and tumor vasculature. The trial is currently enrolling patients with unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors.
